I did not receive the FISP coupon this year, and I cannot afford to buy fertilizer from the shop on my own. I will spread manure from my goats on this plot before planting, and we will use the local maize seed we saved from last harvest. My children and I will do all the work ourselves with our hoes, as we have always done.
